summary: Complete frontend testing of Xbox 360 Dashboard replica (Vortex-Prime-EMU). All 10 features verified successfully. Dashboard displays exactly 5 unique game tiles in Recently Played section (Spider-Man: Web of Shadows, Bionic Commando, Halo 3, Gears of War 2, Red Dead Redemption). No visual overlap between Recently Played and main cards. Guide overlay has 3 tabs (Friends and Parties, Messages, Home). Guide Home tab shows Home, Settings, Shutdown System buttons, plus 5 recently played games with first 3 having Quick Resume badges.

issues: Some game cover images fail to load (Wikipedia URLs returning broken images) - affects Spider-Man, Bionic Commando, Halo 3, Gears of War 2 covers. Red Dead Redemption cover loads correctly.
